relationships.subject: VEGF I/D variant D/D genotype
relationships.evidence_quote: The results provided evidence supporting that the D/D genotype of the VEGF I/D variant is associated with an increased risk of FMF in a group of Turkish populations.

relationships.subject: VEGF I/D variant D/D genotype
relationships.evidence_quote: When we examined the clinical findings, joint pain was more common in patients with VEGF D/D and I/D genotypes compared to I/I genotype (p = 0.043).

key_findings: VEGF I/D D/D genotype was higher in FMF patients than controls.
Joint pain was more common in patients with VEGF D/D and I/D genotypes.
